messages:
maria: Heads-up — PR #18432 is passing locally but mac_e2e keeps flaking. Can someone take the APAC late-night slot if CI stabilizes?
josh: @maria I can cover the APAC handoff tonight. What rebase window do you want me to use?
maria: Need to land before Tue maintenance blackout (schema cutover). Ideally before 03:00 UTC. Will need a rebase onto latest main.
sam: CI shows `integration/wheel` timing out intermittently. Kicked a rebuild: `ci-bot: rerun pipeline for PR 18432` :crossed_fingers: 
ci-bot: Pipeline queued (id: 78901234) for PR #18432 — attempting mac_e2e rerun.
lee: Also needs an approval from @anita for the config tweak in the PR.
anita: looked — left a small nit in the last comment but non-blocking. +1 on the change.
josh: If mac_e2e comes back green, i'll do the rebase and merge during the 22:30 APAC handoff. Ping me when green.
maria: tagged release-oncall FYI — if canary alarms, we revert immediately.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy blackout Tue 03:00-04:30 UTC. Please avoid merges during that window.
maria: noted. if rerun fails we'll queue for tomorrow's canary window.
sam: found a flaky assert, pushing a tiny patch to the branch to avoid the flake.
maria: new commit pushed, CI triggered.
ci-bot: Pipeline 78901235 passed — mac_e2e green for PR #18432.
josh: green. rebasing and landing now.
josh: merged — :tada: rolling to canary.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for commit abcdef1. Monitoring enabled.
maria: thanks everyone — i'll add perf/latency checks to the PR notes and follow up tomorrow.
anita: ack, will review the perf note in the morning.
